note: This sheet is RGB with no alpha channel, so slicing finds one piece covering the whole sheet. That is correct for a fixed-grid plate: select the single piece and use "Split selected on grid" at the layout below. 2166x726 as a 7x1 strip, so its cells are 309x726. It already ships as a hand-written tileset built by art-source/tilesets/normalize_tilesets.py. Exporting over it would rewrite the ids and coordinates that GenMappingRegistry references, so treat this as a sheet to inspect or adopt deliberately, not to re-export casually. Like nature-tiles it loads as a sliced frame-indexed sheet rather than col/row doodads, so re-exporting it would change its registry shape.
